description: December 20 birthday meaning: Sagittarius or Capricorn cusp, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, December 20 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Sagittarius or Capricorn. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The December 20 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: The 20th of December is a cusp date, so the Sun sign depends on the birth year and exact time, though most years still show the late twenties of Sagittarius. Fire meets earth in this blend: Jupiterian optimism with Saturnine realism. The birthday number 2 adds diplomacy, giving a cooperative, practical dreamer who listens before acting.

Astronomically, December 20 puts the Sun near 28° Sagittarius in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Sun. Birthdays around December 20 to December 22 fall on the Sagittarius–Capricorn cusp, near the December solstice. Mutable fire meets cardinal earth, and optimism meets ambition. Which sign the Sun was actually in depends on the year, time and birthplace, as the moment of ingress varies; a chart for your exact details is the way to confirm it. Those who carry both energies are often described as visionaries with a plan, people who dream large and then build methodically. They may swing between restlessness and serious focus, and both modes tend to serve them.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for December 20
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a December 20 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous December 20 birthdays
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 20 is the 354th day of the year (355th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Capricorn, is usually complete within 2 days, by December 22.

By December 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a December 20 birthday are Kylian Mbappé (1998), Abdulrazak Gurnah (1948) and Binali Yıldırım (1955).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 20?
faq.answer: December 20 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Sagittarius or Capricorn on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Sagittarius. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 20 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 20?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by December 20, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 20?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on December 20 include Kylian Mbappé (1998), Abdulrazak Gurnah (1948) and Binali Yıldırım (1955). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
